title: Passion becomes Obsession
author: CashFirm573
selftext: Hi, wanted to share my latest updated, biggest update has been the lighting, and the new assets around the dungeon, still loads of work to go. But world is starting to take shape, I think the next big update will be animations, currently main 3 weapons have 20 skills each and they still lacking in animation, also none of bosses have proper attack animations or patters they mostly sharing normal/rare mobs animations. But definitely a lot of fun making this game, the lore around it is deep and dark, really messed up world and ending, just the way I like it.
